purpose: CUDA compiler comparison inputs; no performance qualification

comparison.source_policy: same committed HEAD and clean tracked diff in both arms
comparison.dependency_policy: same ggml SHA and clean tracked diff
comparison.driver_policy: same installed driver; no driver change authorised

baseline_deltas.STRATA_BUILD_DSV41: ON in both arms; existing release cache was OFF
baseline_deltas.GGML_BMI2: CMake forces OFF with DSV41; same in both arms

runtime.reason: GPU ownership and controller clearance required before any CUDA probe or model load

qwen36.router_policy: preserve Qwen3.6 top-8; verify the selected model metadata agrees before comparison
qwen36.candidate_requirements: check each opt-in format's engine capability, rounding, scales and layout before use; retain the Qwen3.6 FP32 rollback path

qwen38.router_reason: derive from the selected model metadata and preserve its actual expert selection count; P0-A does not bind a selected model
qwen38.kv_reason: freeze the selected model's actual effective precision and layout from metadata and existing engine settings before comparison
qwen38.existing_precision_contract: preserve generic Qwen FP16 QSA pools, grouped-64 INT8, rotated Q4_0 and K8V4 paths as applicable; grouped-64 INT8 is not GGUF Q8_0
qwen38.candidate_reason: no additional formats selected; any proposal needs family-specific capability, rounding, scale and layout checks

deepseek41.router_reason: derive from the selected model metadata and preserve its actual expert selection count; P0-A does not bind a selected model
deepseek41.kv_reason: freeze the selected model's actual effective precision and layout from metadata and existing engine settings before comparison
deepseek41.existing_precision_contract: preserve the FP8 window ring, compressed E2M1/E4M3 KV, separate E2M1/UE8M0 index keys and BF16 working rows; compressed latent rows and index keys retain their distinct rounding, scale and layout contracts
deepseek41.candidate_reason: no additional formats selected; any proposal needs DeepSeek-specific capability, rounding, scale and compressed-latent/index-key layout checks

runtime.unset_reason: must freeze actual model/pack identity, effective quantisation, MTP and family-specific settings before runtime comparison; no model metadata collected in P0-A
